Figure 3: Summary of the proposed approach. (a) Overall structure features a Feature Modulation Module (FMM) consisting of two modules: GFM and HLM. (b) Parameter Selection fusion method in GFM method: We calculate the relative change rate of GFM parameters to obtain the parameters related to general knowledge. (c) Schematic of HLM method. We segment the HLM parameters using the Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) method and assign segmented parameter subspaces to different incremental tasks to learn the corresponding specific knowledge.
